_doc: TPCR-TWEET-RESTYLE-CUTOVER: the ONLY place the format window and the new-format reply tiers are set. reply_tier_a/reply_tier_b: |observed - forecast| WTI cutoffs, set by Fred Oct 28 2026 to A=3.0, B=6.0 (miss <= A ✅, A < miss <= B ⬇️/⬆️, > B ⏬/⏫; unset or invalid = new-format reply skipped_bad_config). Read by operations/scripts/tweet_format.py. Times are America/New_York (EDT, UTC-4, on both dates; DST ends 02:00 Nov 1, after old_retires). discord_cta (TPCR-DISCORD-GROWTH-001, Fred Nov 18 2026): appends 'Free daily forecasts live on our Discord: https://discord.gg/<code>' to the 8:30 AM OBSERVED reply only (never the FORECAST post). code = the Discord invite 'x-daily' code; first_post_date/last_post_date = America/Toronto posting dates (the day the reply goes out, not park day D), YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, last = first + 13 days (14 posts, max). Set by the chief at the Mini deploy. All null = line off; partial or invalid = line off plus one ERROR on stderr. After last_post_date the line stops on its own.
